sections.title: I. Ngữ âm
sections.instruction: Câu 1–3: phát âm; câu 4–5: trọng âm.

sections.title: II. Chọn đáp án đúng
sections.instruction: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.

items.prompt: Look! The boys ___ football.
items.explain: "Look!": hiện tại tiếp diễn, the boys: are playing.

items.prompt: ___ there any milk in the bottle?
items.explain: milk không đếm được: Is there any…?

items.prompt: This book is ___ than that one.
items.explain: Tính từ dài: more interesting than.

items.prompt: I usually have dinner ___ 7 p.m.
My father can ___ three languages.
How ___ apples do you want?
We didn't go out ___ it was raining.
You ___ eat too many sweets. They are bad for your teeth.
What's the weather ___ in Da Lat?
items.explain: Hỏi thời tiết: What's the weather like?

items.prompt: She ___ her homework yesterday evening.

sections.title: III. Chia động từ
sections.instruction: Gõ dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc.

items.prompt: My friends (play) ___ chess at the moment.
Where (you / go) ___ last summer?
items.explain: Câu hỏi quá khứ: did you go.

items.prompt: Mai (have) ___ long black hair.
We (not watch) ___ TV last night.
items.explain: Phủ định quá khứ: didn't watch.

items.prompt: Next week, my class (have) ___ a picnic.
items.explain: "Next week": tương lai, will have / is going to have.

sections.title: IV. Điền từ vào đoạn văn
sections.instruction: Chọn từ đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: A letter from Mai
items.passage:
Dear Lucy,
Thank you (21) ___ your letter. I'm very happy to hear from you. Now I'm (22) ___ Ha Long Bay with my family. We arrived here (23) ___ Monday. The weather is sunny and (24) ___, so we swim in the sea every day. Yesterday, we (25) ___ a boat trip around the bay. We saw many beautiful islands and caves. The seafood here is very (26) ___. Tomorrow we are going (27) ___ Tuan Chau Island. I'll (28) ___ you some photos when I get home. What (29) ___ you going to do this summer? Please write to me (30) ___.
Love, Mai

items.explain: Ở một vùng/địa danh lớn: in Ha Long Bay.
Trời nắng và được tắm biển mỗi ngày: sunny and hot.
be going + to V: going to visit.
I'll + động từ nguyên mẫu: send.
be going to: What are you going to do?
Lời kết thư: write to me soon.

sections.title: V. Đọc hiểu
sections.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng.

items.title: Snowy the rabbit
items.passage: Kim has a pet rabbit called Snowy. Snowy is white and has long ears. Kim got him for her ninth birthday from her aunt. Every morning before school, Kim gives Snowy some fresh carrots and clean water. Snowy lives in a big cage in the garden, but at the weekend Kim lets him run on the grass. Snowy is very quiet, and he does not like loud noises. When Kim's little brother plays the drum, Snowy hides under a box.

items.prompt: What colour is Snowy?
Who gave Snowy to Kim?
When does Kim feed Snowy?
Where does Snowy usually live?
options: In a cage in the garden
items.explain: "lives in a big cage in the garden".

items.prompt: Why does Snowy hide under a box?
items.explain: Khi em trai chơi trống (tiếng ồn), Snowy trốn.

sections.instruction: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa không đổi.
